name: projector
description: Local Linux application and project launcher with a GTK palette, web workspace and terminals

scripts.build: vp run architecture && vp run gtk:types && vp run vio:build && vue-tsc --noEmit && vp build
scripts.test: vp run architecture && vp run test:architecture && vp run vio:test && node --test tests/codex.test.mjs tests/opencode.test.mjs tests/claude.test.mjs tests/cursor.test.mjs tests/agent.test.mjs tests/os.test.mjs tests/ide.test.mjs tests/launcher.test.mjs tests/integrations.test.mjs tests/secrets.test.mjs tests/clone-jobs.test.mjs tests/reconcile.test.mjs tests/devcontainer.test.mjs tests/devcontainer-live.test.mjs tests/github-browser.test.mjs tests/workspace-sources.test.mjs tests/terminal.test.mjs tests/terminal-input.test.mjs tests/workspace.test.mjs tests/git-history.test.mjs tests/git-graph.test.mjs tests/git-branches.test.mjs tests/git-split.test.mjs tests/workspace-session.test.mjs tests/preview-tabs.test.mjs tests/dock-layout.test.mjs tests/project-routing.test.mjs tests/tree-selection.test.mjs tests/tree-page.test.mjs tests/tree-pagination.test.mjs tests/markdown-editor.test.mjs tests/code-editor.test.mjs tests/virtual-list.test.mjs tests/archives.test.mjs tests/file-icons.test.mjs tests/restart.test.mjs tests/tab-registry.test.mjs tests/network-mode.test.mjs tests/access-security.test.mjs && node tests/launcher-model.test.mjs
scripts.vio:gtk-test: vp run --filter vio test:gtk && node --import vio/register tests/catalog-gtk.test.mjs
scripts.test:live: PROJECTOR_TEST_DOCKER=1 PROJECTOR_TEST_DEVCONTAINER=1 node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/environment-live.test.mjs tests/reconcile.test.mjs tests/devcontainer-live.test.mjs tests/sigkill-live.test.mjs
scripts.check: vp run test && vp run test:docker && vp run build
